verdict.rationale: Google Cloud's first-party free page says new customers get $300 in free credit and are not charged until they activate a full paid account. It also describes an always-free tier: AI APIs, Compute Engine, BigQuery and other products are free up to monthly limits, not charged against the credit. Missing for 10: the credit's expiry period is not stated, per-product free-usage limit figures are not quoted, a dedicated startup credits program is not evidenced, and there is no independent or hands-on corroboration.
